args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Brightline Freight's latest newsletter covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" and links to its feature article on the Brightline blog.
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Carrier pilots cut claims by a quarter.
